records.title: 800ms timeout reproduces failure
records.content: EU card checkout reproduction against the payment sandbox times out with an 800ms payment authorization deadline.

records.title: 1500ms timeout passes
records.content: The same reproduction completes authorization in 1170ms when the deadline is raised to 1500ms.

records.title: US card checkout remains healthy
records.content: US card checkout reproduction completes in 430ms with either timeout value, matching the metrics that scope the impact to EU card authorization.

records.title: Wallet checkout unaffected
records.content: Wallet checkout bypasses PaymentProvider.authorize and succeeds in the reproduction harness without changing the timeout.
